plans.name: Duplicate SKU split
plans.idea: The PayPal amount builder may deduplicate repeated SKUs while fulfilment iterates every raw order line.
plans.expect: Three hoodies shipped while PayPal captures only $49.00.

plans.name: Currency blind spot
plans.idea: The create-order handler may pass a client currency to PayPal while capture verification compares only the numeric amount, ignoring currency_code.
plans.expect: One hoodie fulfilled after paying ¥49 instead of $49.

plans.name: Approve small, swap latest order
plans.idea: After approval, creating another shop order may replace a session or latest-order pointer; capturing the first PayPal order might then fulfil the newest local order instead of the order bound to that PayPal ID.
plans.expect: Five hoodies shipped for the $49 captured from the first approved order.

plans.name: Capture body supplies old capture
plans.idea: The capture endpoint may trust captureId and status supplied in its request body instead of obtaining and binding a capture from the PayPal order in the path.
plans.expect: The newly approved order is fulfilled although its own PayPal order is never captured; the earlier $49 capture is reused.

plans.name: Born-fulfilled order
plans.idea: Order creation may mass-assign status, payment, or capture fields from the client, allowing an order to be created already treated as paid and reusing an earlier capture identifier.
plans.expect: Two hoodies shipped with no approval or capture for the new order.

plans.name: Cross-order webhook retarget
plans.idea: The webhook handler may route by the edited resource.custom_id and merely check that resource.id is a real completed $49 capture, without requiring that capture's original shop order or PayPal order to match the routed order.
plans.expect: The newly approved but uncaptured order is fulfilled using the earlier order's completed capture.
